name: granttap
description: Pair local coding agents with GrantTap and approve, answer, or steer their work from iPhone and Apple Watch.

interface.shortDescription: Control coding agents from iPhone and Apple Watch.
interface.longDescription: Connect GrantTap from Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, or Grok Build through granttap.com. Pair this computer with a one-time iPhone QR, authorize each coding app, and reconnect only when you confirm replacing the current pairing. Then approve requests, answer questions, and continue local coding-agent tasks from iPhone or Apple Watch. Provider sign-in is separate.
defaultPrompt: Check whether this computer is connected to GrantTap.
